description: This file defines a PHPUnit test utility class 'DoctrineService' extending 'Doctrine'. It customizes entity manager retrieval to ensure the entity manager is open, reinitializing if necessary. The class is used within the test suite for database-related testing in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DoctrineService
classes.description: A utility class for testing that extends 'Doctrine' to manage EntityManager instances, ensuring an open EntityManager is used during tests.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return an open EntityManager, reinitializing if the current one is closed.
